description:
Start paper-copying a fund with a slider allocation.

    Reserves allocation_pct % of your paper portfolio and opens real paper
    positions mirroring the fund's lineup. The copy follows the manager's
    moves automatically (new bots open, removed ones close, ~60s sync).

    PAPER ONLY — never touches a live account or an exchange. Live accounts
    are refused; running your own fund is also a conflict.

    Args:
        fund_id: The fund to copy.
        allocation_pct: % of your paper portfolio (1-100, default 100=all-in,
            which pauses your own router deployment by draining free cash).
name: start_fund_copy
